title: Para Asian Games: Manasi-Thulasimathi Assure India of Medal
indian_angle: Indian duo Manasi and Thulasimathi have guaranteed a medal for the country at the Asian Para Games.
summary: India's para-badminton contingent started strong at the Asian Para Games, with Manasi-Thulasimathi guaranteeing a medal and several players like Krishna Nagar, Nitesh Kumar, and Pramod Bhagat securing wins.

title: Suhas LY Makes Winning Start at Asian Para Games
indian_angle: Indian para-badminton player Suhas LY began his Asian Para Games campaign with a victory.
summary: Suhas LY made a winning start in the Asian Para Games badminton event, marking a positive beginning for the Indian contingent.

title: Khangurra Reaches World Junior Semis, Assures India a Medal
indian_angle: Jagsher Singh Khangurra's advancement to the semifinals guarantees India a medal at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: Jagsher Singh Khangurra secured a medal for India by reaching the semifinals of the Cairo BWF World Junior Championships, coming from behind to defeat Yuan-Syue Jhuang.

title: Treesa Jolly-Gayatri Gopichand Reach Quarterfinals
indian_angle: The Indian women's doubles pair of Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand have successfully advanced to the quarterfinals.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand, who won their maiden World Championships bronze in August, defeated an Indonesian pair 21-16, 21-17 to enter the quarterfinals.

title: Kidambi Srikanth's Valiant Effort Ends in Defeat
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Kidambi Srikanth's strong performance ultimately wasn't enough to secure a win.
summary: Despite a valiant effort, Kidambi Srikanth was eliminated from the tournament, with his campaign ending after a tough match.
